paite: Huan Gilead gam a Tishbi a mi Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA, ama a ka dinna Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Keimah thu lou in kum bangzah hiam sung daitui leh vuah azu kei ding," achi hi.
heading: Elijah Leh Khokheng

paite: TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi,
"Hiai a pan pawt inla, suahlam zuan in pai inla, Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah va kibu in.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai luitui na dawn dia; huai ah nang hon vak ding in va-ak thu ka pe khinta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in akuan a, TOUPA thu bang in ahihta hi. Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah atengta hi.
Va-akte'n zingsang in tanghou leh sa ahong puak zel ua, nitaklam in tanghou leh sa ahong puak nawn zel uhi. Huai luitui adawn hi.
Anung deuh in hichi ahong hi a, huai gam a vuah himhim azuk louh ziak in lui ahong kangta hi.
TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Elijah Leh Zarephath A Meithainu

paite: "Thou inla, Zidon gam a Zarephath ah hoh inla, huai ah om in. Nang hon vak ding in meithai khat thu ka pe khinta," achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, Zarephath ah ahohta hi. Huai khokulh kongpi atun in, ngai in, meithai khat sing tom in ana om a; amah asam a, "Bel in tui tawmchik hon la dih ve, ka na dawn ding," achi hi.
La dia kuan asam a, "Tanghou neuchik bek hon tawi lechin," achi hi.

Ama'n, TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in, ka gen hi. "Tanghou ka nei kei, bel ah tangbuang pham khat lel leh thawl ah sathau tawmchik kia ka nei hi. Ngai in, ka pai chia ka tapa a dia bawlna ding singkang nih hiam lel ka tom a, huchi in ka ne ding ua, ka si mai ding uh," achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, na gen bang in va hih in. Himahleh huai in tanghou neuchik petmah hon bawlsak phot inla, huai hon tawi inla, huai khit chiang in nang a ding leh na tapa a ding na bawl ding hi.
TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA'N leitung a vuah ahon zuksak masiah tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei dia, sathau thawl leng akang kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elijah gen bang in ahih a; amah leh a-inkote leh Elijah toh ni tamtak ane uhi.
Elijah zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei a, sathau thawl leng akang sam kei hi.
Huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei, inn neinu tapa china in ahong gim mahmah a, anak ahong beita hi.
heading: Meithai Tapa Hihdamna

paite: Ama'n Elijah kiang ah, "Nang Pathian mipa aw, ka tung a lungkimlouhna bang nei na hia? Ka khelhna hon theikhesak ding leh ka tapa hon thahsak dia hong pai na hi ve!" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na tapa hon pia in," achi hi. Huchi in apom lai ala a, a-omna dantan ah apom tou a, alupna ah asial hi.
TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, ka tenna meithainu tung ah leh atapa hihlupsak in thil hoih lou hon tungsakta na hi maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in naupang tung ah thumvei bokkhup in, TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, hehpih in hiai naupang hinna asung ah hon omsak nawn in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Elijah thu ana ngaihkhiaksak hi. Hichi in naupang hinna amah sung ah ahong om nawn a, ahong halh nawnta hi.
Elijah in naupang api a, dantan a pan insung ah apaipihsuk a, anu apia hi. Elijah in, “En in, na tapa ahing hi," achi hi.
Numei in Elijah kiang ah, "Tu in Pathian mipa na hi a, na kam a TOUPA thu thutak ahi, chih ka theita," achi hi.
